That puts col 0 at 253.3 px and row 0 at 595.3 px; direct measurement gives 253.0 (column centres 253.0/295.5/337.5) and 594.0 +- 1.5 (tail caps). Scores: rule raw 0.9330 / tol1 0.9838, measured raw 0.9185 / tol1 0.9853.
